bugs_found: compound_interest uses r / years instead of r / compounds_per_year, producing materially wrong interest results
compound_interest allows years == 0 and then divides by zero instead of returning principal or rejecting input
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing inputs without validation
transfer is not atomic: debit is applied before credit, so malformed account_to.balance or other credit-time failure can leave balances inconsistent
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal, so float or invalid numeric inputs can crash or behave inconsistently
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount, with no validation or flooring
fx_convert accepts zero or negative exchange rates, allowing zeroed or negative converted amounts
